body:
Real gap: SHADER_IPS_LIGHT/SHADER_HPS_LIGHT only forced their own box to full brightness, nothing made nearby walls brighter the way the flashlight's flashlight_face_boost already does. Added fixture_light_face_contribution/fixture_lights_gather: same per-face N.L + distance-falloff shape as the flashlight, but omnidirectional with each source's own real color (cool white-blue IPS, warm amber HPS pre-multiplied by hps_flicker so nearby walls flicker too). Live-verified via Xvfb: numerically confirmed the per-face contribution (+0.6/+0.65/+0.7 on a backdrop box directly behind an IPS panel), then visually confirmed against a gridded backdrop showing a real warm halo spilling from the panel and fading with distance -- a single-box test initially looked like no change since this lighting model is per-box flat shading, not per-pixel; caught and fixed the test, not the implementation. All three build paths clean. Commit 28bd7fa.

⚓ ☃
title: IPS/HPS light fixtures now cast real light on nearby walls
